title: ERA5 bootstrap significance, event agreement and robustness testing
reason_for_winter_block_bootstrap: Multiple cold-spell events can occur within one winter and may not be statistically independent.
multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate correction applied separately to each field and lag
bootstrap_grid: ERA5 fields coarsened from 0.25 degree to approximately 1 degree before grid-cell bootstrap
reason_for_coarsening: Focuses inference on regional-scale circulation rather than grid-scale noise
Reduces excessive spatial dependence among adjacent 0.25 degree cells
interpretation_rule: Composite anomalies indicate statistical association and do not alone prove causality, Rossby-wave forcing, stratospheric forcing or polar-vortex influence.
